name: Ane Yome Concerto
original_name: あねよめコンチェルト
source:
This is a fandisc for Aneyome Quartet which contains after stories for the 5 main heroines (Yurina, Momone, Saori, Anzu, Minamo), plus an ‘if’ story where he did not choose any of the Hanabishi sisters as his fiancée. Two new foreign heroines Maria and Sylvie appear; they were adopted by the Hidaka family and are now his older sisters.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/09/01/september-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是一张Aneyome Quartet的同人光盘，其中包含5位主要女主角（Yurina、Momonone、Saori、Anzu、Minamo）的后续故事，以及一个“如果”故事，其中他没有选择Hanabishi姐妹中的任何一个作为他的未婚妻。两位新的外国女主角玛丽亚和西尔维出现；她们被日高一家收养，现在是他的姐姐。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/09/01/september-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
